title: Lanao del Norte, 7 towns bag 2026 Gawad Kalasag Gold Award

blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY- The province of Lanao del Norte and seven of its towns received gold recognitions during the 2026 Gawad Kalasag Seal of Excellence Award. The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC) presented the awards during a ceremony hosted by the Office of Civil Defense-10 (OCD-10) in Cagayan de Oro City on Tuesday, Nov. 24. Abeliza Manzano, chief of the Lanao del Norte Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO), said this is the fifth consecutive year the province is awarded such recognition.
